name: BELIEVER!
source:
"Once in a thousand years, the door to a parallel world opens, bringing strange beings into our world.

However, when this time comes and the world falls into chaos, the legendary miko* and her guardians will be our saviours--"

Following the prophecy that has been passed down for several thousand years in history, the door to a parallel world suddenly opens, and strange beings appear before a group of high-school students who had been living peaceful lives.

These students accept their fate — to become the miko and her guardians — and decide to fight in order to save their world.

[From [URL=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2015/09/14/believer-introduction/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/URL].]
translation:
“一千年一次，平行世界的大门打开，将陌生的生物带入我们的世界。

然而，当这个时刻到来，世界陷入混乱时，传说中的巫女*和她的守护者将成为我们的救世主——”

随着历史上流传数千年的预言，平行世界的大门突然打开，奇怪的生物出现在一群原本过着平静生活的高中生面前。

这些学生接受了自己的命运——成为巫女和她的守护者——并决定为拯救他们的世界而战斗。

[来自[URL=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2015/09/14/believer-introduction/]Rie的Otoge博客[/URL]。]
